module.constraint: eval('/* TAU Clock Frequency must be 6.25x greater than the baud rate for the slave to measure the sync byte within +/- 2% error */' + 'var operation_clock_tau = {' + ' "module.driver.timer.operation_clock.CK00": "${board.clock.peripheral.tau.ck00}",' + ' "module.driver.timer.operation_clock.CK01": "${board.clock.peripheral.tau.ck01}",' + ' "module.driver.timer.operation_clock.CK02": "${board.clock.peripheral.tau.ck02}",' + ' "module.driver.timer.operation_clock.CK03": "${board.clock.peripheral.tau.ck03}",' + '};' + 'function check_bitrate_valid(f_mck,baud){' + ' var message = null;' + ' var min_tau_f_mck = Math.floor(baud*25/4);' + ' if (("module.driver.sau_lin.mode.mode_slave" == mode) && (f_mck < min_tau_f_mck))' + ' {' + ' message = "TAU Operation Clock Frequency must be at least "+ min_tau_f_mck + "Hz for sync byte measurement at the selected baud rate.";' + ' }' + ' return message;' + '}' + 'var mode = "${module.driver.sau_lin.mode}";' + 'var operation_clock = "${module.driver.sau_lin.requires.tau::module.driver.timer.operation_clock}";' + 'var f_mck=operation_clock_tau[operation_clock];' + 'var baud="${module.driver.sau_lin.requires.sau_uart::module.driver.uart.baud}";' + '' + 'check_bitrate_valid(f_mck,baud)')

property.export: eval('/* Converter for SAU unit to configured operation clock frequency */' + 'var fclk_freq_by_unit_get = {' + ' "0": function (operation_clock) { return operation_clock === "0" ? ${board.clock.peripheral.sau.ck00} : ${board.clock.peripheral.sau.ck01}; },' + ' "1": function (operation_clock) { return operation_clock === "0" ? ${board.clock.peripheral.sau.ck10} : ${board.clock.peripheral.sau.ck11}; },' + '};' + '' + '/* Function to calculate SDR.STCLK register value. Note: This function does not check whether the value is in range. */' + 'function stclk_calculate(f_mck, bitrate)' + '{' + ' return Math.round(f_mck / (2 * bitrate)) - 1;' + '}' + '' + '/* Function to calculate SAU unit value */' + 'function sau_unit_calculate(channel) {' + ' return Math.floor(channel / 2);' + '}' + 'function stclk_calculate_break_field(f_mck, bitrate)' + '{' + ' return Math.ceil(f_mck / (2 * bitrate)) - 1;' + '}' + '' + 'var stclk_limits = { min : 2, max : 127 };' + 'var f_iclk = ${board.clock.peripheral.sau};' + 'var prs = Math.floor(Math.log(f_iclk/f_mck)/Math.log(2));' + '' + '' + 'function bitrate_calculate(bitrate, sau_unit, operation_clock, stclk_limits) {' + ' /* Look up SAU operation clock frequency */' + ' var f_mck = fclk_freq_by_unit_get[sau_unit](operation_clock);' + '' + ' /* Calculate SDR.STCLK register value */' + ' var stclk = stclk_calculate_break_field(f_mck, bitrate);' + '' + ' /* Cap the setting within the valid register range */' + ' stclk = Math.min(stclk, stclk_limits.max);' + ' stclk = Math.max(stclk, stclk_limits.min);' + '' + ' /* Calculate actual bitrate with this SDR.STCLK value for printing in the comment */' + ' var actual_bitrate = f_mck / (2 * (stclk + 1));' + '' + ' return "/* Actual calculated bitrate: " + actual_bitrate.toFixed(0) + " */\\n" +' + ' ".stclk = " + stclk.toString();' + '}' + '' + 'var bitrate_break_field = Math.floor(bitrate * 9 / 13);' + 'var c_bitrate_break_field = bitrate_calculate(bitrate_break_field, sau_unit, operation_clock, stclk_limits);' + 'c_bitrate_break_field += ",\\n.prs = " + prs.toString();' + '' + 'c_bitrate_break_field')
